categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent card manufacturing, including telecom SIM cards, financial IC cards, and ID cards, along with dedicated chip production for smart cards. It also engages in semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on semiconductor packaging materials and digital and energy thermal management products. Additionally, the company is expanding into AIoT products and smart security integrated services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced semiconductor packaging technologies such as lead frame design and production, including products for MOSFET, IGBT, and SiC power modules. It employs automated optical inspection (AOI) and smart manufacturing processes to enhance production efficiency and quality. The R&D focuses on chip encryption, anti-side-channel attack masking, RFID-based chip detection, eSIM data plane positioning, and multi-modal biometric authentication technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading smart card system companies such as THALES and IDEMIA, serving industries like mobile communications, financial payment, and public utilities. The company targets domestic telecom operators, financial institutions, and overseas markets in Southeast Asia, Middle East, Africa, and South America. It also serves emerging sectors like new energy vehicles, digital energy, and AI server thermal management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production centers in Shenzhen, Shanghai, Ningbo, and overseas locations including New Delhi, India, and Jakarta, Indonesia. It has a significant overseas market presence, leveraging mature management systems to serve global customers, especially in emerging international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on semiconductor chip design, packaging, and smart card manufacturing. It provides integrated services including chip production, packaging materials, and comprehensive smart card solutions, positioning itself as a one-stop service provider in the smart card and semiconductor ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes technology innovation driven by R&D in smart cards, dedicated chips, semiconductor packaging materials, AIoT, and digital thermal management. It aims to extend its industrial chain and explore new application fields such as 5G, AI, IoT, and smart security. R&D projects include RFID chip detection, anti-side-channel attack encryption, eSIM positioning, and intelligent security inspection systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of smart card products, semiconductor chips, and packaging materials. The company also earns income from comprehensive card manufacturing services and leasing business. It follows a direct sales model based on customer orders, with some products produced via self-design and outsourced processing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the smart card and dedicated chip market in China, with strong scale advantages and comprehensive industry chain coverage. It competes with global smart card system providers and semiconductor packaging material manufacturers. Its competitive edge lies in integrated solutions, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and strong customer relationships with major telecom operators and financial institutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 360 million, a decrease of 8.65% from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.57 million, up 29.77%. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 790 million and a net asset of RMB 677 million. Despite revenue decline due to market fluctuations, profitability improved through cost control and efficiency gains.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance, low-power, secure, and reliable integrated solutions for smart cards and semiconductor products. It differentiates itself through end-to-end industry chain coverage, advanced intelligent manufacturing, flexible modular chip services, and comprehensive smart card production capabilities. Its strong R&D and patent portfolio, combined with global customer partnerships and multi-product diversification, provide competitive advantages in technology and service quality.
